Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto let you access navigation, music, and messaging right from the Trailblazer s display without cords, so your phone s key apps are available in a safer, more convenient way while you drive.

*Forward collision mitigation* constantly monitors traffic ahead and can intervene to help avoid or lessen the severity of a frontal impact, giving you an extra layer of protection when split-second responses matter.

*Front pedestrian impact prevention* actively scans for people and can take action to reduce the chance of striking a pedestrian, improving confidence when driving in busy areas or parking lots.

*Lane departure prevention* helps maintain your position within the lane by applying subtle corrective inputs if the vehicle begins to drift, adding peace of mind on highways and during long drives.

*Brake assist* senses panic braking and delivers maximum available stopping force when you need to stop quickly, supporting shorter stopping distances in sudden-hazard situations.

Cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls holds your chosen speed and lets you make adjustments without taking your hands off the wheel, which reduces fatigue on road trips and can help improve fuel efficiency.

Keyfob engine start control lets you remotely start the vehicle so the cabin is comfortable before you get in, a small convenience that makes a big difference on hot or cold days.

A responsive *touchscreen* centralizes infotainment and vehicle settings into an intuitive interface, so essential controls are easy to reach and use while you re on the move.

*Smart device mirroring* lets your phone s apps and navigation appear on the Jetta s infotainment display, so you can access music, directions and messages more naturally while keeping attention on the road.

*Forward collision mitigation* provides an extra level of vigilance ahead of you, sensing sudden stops and intervening to help reduce the chance or severity of a frontal impact.

The *active blind spot system* alerts you to vehicles in adjacent lanes and helps prevent risky lane changes, giving you greater confidence when merging or passing in heavy traffic.

*Rear collision mitigation* watches behind the car and prepares safety systems when a rear impact is detected as possible, offering peace of mind during stop-and-go traffic or when parked on the street.

*Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go* makes highway travel less tiring by maintaining a safe following distance and automatically slowing or stopping with traffic, then resuming when traffic moves again.

*Brake assist* boosts emergency stopping power by detecting rapid pedal application and applying maximum brake force, helping you react more effectively in sudden situations.

*Selective Internet access* lets you customize connected services and information feeds so the in-car experience delivers the news, scores and updates you want without unnecessary clutter.

Altogether, the 2019 Volkswagen Jetta SEL Auto w/ULEV blends efficient turbocharged performance with thoughtful safety and connectivity features, creating a comfortable, well-rounded sedan for commuters and small families. If you want a compact car that feels mature, connected and secure on the road, this Jetta is worth a close look and a test drive to see how it fits your daily routine.

Option Group 01 packages practical upgrades that streamline daily life and elevate cabin comfort so your drives feel more relaxed and efficient without adding complexity.

Smart device mirroring brings familiar phone apps onto the Tucson s touchscreen so navigation, music and calls are easier to access while you keep your focus on the road.

Front pedestrian impact prevention adds proactive detection of people ahead and helps the vehicle take evasive or mitigating actions, enhancing confidence when traveling through busy sidewalks and crosswalks.

Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go turns long drives and congested commutes into less fatiguing experiences by maintaining a safe following distance and stopping and restarting automatically with traffic flow.

Brake assist senses emergency braking and applies extra stopping force when needed, helping reduce stopping distances in sudden situations so you can respond more decisively.

Cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls keeps speed adjustments within easy reach so you can relax your right foot on extended trips while maintaining consistent pace and comfort.

The power open and close liftgate makes loading groceries and gear simpler by letting you access the cargo area hands-free or with a button, saving time and effort when your hands are full.

Ventilated front seats circulate cool air where you need it, helping you settle in faster on hot days and reducing reliance on cabin air conditioning for immediate comfort.

Heated driver and front passenger seats provide quick, targeted warmth on chilly mornings to help you get comfortable sooner and stay relaxed during colder drives.

Leather seat upholstery gives the cabin a refined feel, offering a stylish, easy-to-clean surface that adds a touch of premium comfort for daily commutes and longer outings.

Forward collision mitigation continuously watches the road ahead and prepares the vehicle and its occupants for sudden slowdowns, helping to reduce the likelihood or severity of frontal impacts.

Altogether, the 2019 Hyundai Tucson Ultimate FWD with Option Group 01 blends user-friendly technology, thoughtful comfort features and proactive safety systems into a versatile compact SUV package. description:
The 2027 Ford Expedition Max King Ranch delivers premium three-row capability with sophisticated styling and impressive performance. This white exterior SUV commands attention on any road while the turbocharged EcoBoost engine provides responsive power and efficiency. Step inside to discover a cabin crafted for luxury and comfort, where every detail reflects the King Ranch's distinguished heritage.

- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 22 speakers
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio (3-year plan included)
- Heated and ventilated premium leather front captain's chairs with memory
- Google Maps navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Panoramic Vista Roof with power moonroof operation
- 22-inch sinister bronze diamond-cut aluminum wheels
- Heated steering wheel with leather wrap and memory functions
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Electronic stability control with traction control and four-wheel independent suspension
- Exterior rear parking camera with 911 Assist emergency communication

The King Ranch trim elevates the Expedition experience with premium leather appointments throughout the cabin, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seats for year-round comfort. Genuine wood accents on the dashboard and door panels add warmth and refinement. The split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row bench provide flexible seating for passengers and cargo. Advanced technology features include the Ford Digital Experience, Ford Connectivity Package with seven years of service, and Google Maps navigation seamlessly integrated with smartphone connectivity. From the memory functions for seats and steering wheel to the tilt and telescoping steering column, every convenience has been thoughtfully included.

This three-row powerhouse combines capability with luxury. The 3.5-liter turbocharged EcoBoost V6 with 10-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive delivers 15 city and 22 highway miles per gallon. Whether you're navigating tight corners with speed-sensing steering or tackling challenging terrain, the suspension and electronic systems work together to keep you confident and composed. Dual front and side airbags, overhead airbags, and a comprehensive safety suite protect your family on every journey.

description: The 2027 Ford Expedition Active introduces a cutting-edge technology ecosystem, highlighted by the Ford Digital Experience and a prominent infotainment interface designed for seamless connectivity. This SUV is engineered for modern digital lifestyles, supporting advanced smartphone integration and intuitive controls that keep drivers and passengers connected at every turn. With its expansive digital cockpit and support for app-based features, the Expedition Active ensures that entertainment, navigation, and communication are always within reach for everyone on board. Tech-savvy families and professionals who demand constant connectivity and up-to-date digital features will appreciate what this SUV delivers. Whether commuting in St. Louis or embarking on a cross-country journey, users benefit from the effortless integration of navigation, music, and communication apps. The Ford Digital Experience and Touring Package cater to those who rely on their devices for both work and leisure, providing an ideal environment for staying productive and entertained on the road. Performance in this SUV is enhanced by a suite of electronic driving aids and an advanced EcoBoost 3.5L V6 GTDi DOHC 24V Twin Turbocharged engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission. The 4WD system, combined with digital drive controls, offers adaptable performance across weather conditions and terrain. Electronic throttle response and selectable drive modes allow for a customized driving feel, optimizing power delivery and comfort whether navigating urban traffic or heading out of town. Safety in the Expedition Active is engineered around smart protection, integrating advanced sensor arrays and camera technologies. Features like Intersection Assist and Lane Change Assist use real-time data processing to detect potential hazards, alert the driver, and even intervene to mitigate collisions. The SUV employs a network of electronic systems that constantly monitor surroundings, enhancing driver awareness and actively working to prevent accidents before they happen. Key features include the Equipment Group 202A Touring Package, which elevates the driving experience through technology-centric amenities and convenience. The Ford Digital Experience serves as the heart of the vehicle's connectivity suite, supporting app-based controls, hands-free communication, and integrated navigation.

Driving Assistance Professional Package: Includes Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keeping Assist, Evasion Assist, Cross-Traffic Alert, and Driver Monitoring.

Executive Package: Features a heated steering wheel, Remote Engine Start, and Head-Up Display.

Parking Assistance Package: Includes Automatic Parking, Rear Parking Aid, Back-Up Camera, and Aerial View Display System.

M Shadowline Lights: Add a distinctive darkened appearance that complements the M4's aggressive styling.

Convertible Soft Top: Delivers the freedom of open-air motoring while maintaining the M4's unmistakable performance character.

This 2023 BMW M4 Competition xDrive Convertible combines thrilling M performance, advanced all-wheel-drive capability, premium luxury, and open-air excitement. Available at BMW of Palm Springs, it delivers an unforgettable expression of BMW M engineering.

The 2025 Ford F-450 XL Regular Cab 4x4 at Stillwell Ford in Hillsdale, MI is a completed commercial work truck powered by the 6.7L Power Stroke V8 Turbo Diesel paired with Ford s 10-speed automatic transmission and equipped with a professionally installed 14' x 94.75 Knapheide Heavy Hauler Jr. steel platform. With the High Capacity Trailer Tow Package, 4x4, and purpose-built Knapheide upfit, this F-450 is ready for contractors, equipment operators, building suppliers, landscapers, and commercial fleets that need serious hauling and towing capability.

The 6.7L Power Stroke V8 Turbo Diesel provides the power expected from an F-450 commercial platform, while the 10-speed automatic and 4x4 capability make this truck ready for demanding jobs and changing conditions. The High Capacity Trailer Tow Package and integrated trailer brake controller add valuable capability when equipment or additional cargo needs to follow behind.

The centerpiece is the 14-foot-long by 94.75-inch-wide Knapheide Heavy Hauler Jr. steel platform. Its substantial 2-inch treated dense pine tongue-and-groove deck provides a durable working surface, while reinforced external stake pockets add flexibility for securing loads and configuring the platform around different hauling requirements.

A 40-inch-high heavy-duty welded bulkhead with punched window helps protect the cab while maintaining rearward visibility. At the rear, a swept-back 2-1/2-inch Reese receiver hitch and 7-way RV-blade trailer connector integrate towing capability directly into the completed upfit. This isn't an unfinished chassis waiting for someone to figure out what comes next. The working body is already there.

Inside the Regular Cab, SYNC 4 with an 8-inch touchscreen, Ford Pass, and Remote Keyless Entry provide useful connectivity and everyday functionality without overcomplicating a truck whose primary purpose is getting work accomplished.

For businesses searching for a 2025 Ford F-450 4x4 platform truck, 14-foot Knapheide flatbed, Power Stroke diesel work truck, contractor truck, equipment hauler, or commercial flatbed, this F-450 combines Super Duty capability with a professionally installed Knapheide Heavy Hauler Jr. platform that's ready to be put into service.

Because Everything We Do Is Driven By You.

Serving drivers across Southern Michigan, Northern Ohio, and Northern Indiana, Stillwell Ford in Hillsdale, MI is your destination for the 2025 Ford F-450. Visit us on M-99 today to take your test drive or contact our team to learn more about current lease and financing offers!

This powertrain provides the balance of efficiency and capability that today's drivers demand, whether navigating daily commutes or longer journeys.

Inside, the cabin reflects meticulous attention to detail. The leather and suede seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seats create an environment of comfort across all three rows. The heated steering wheel and power-adjustable front seats with memory settings ensure personalized comfort for every drive. Climate control is comprehensive, with automatic temperature management front and rear.

Technology enhances both safety and convenience throughout your ownership. The Mark Levinson audio system with 21 speakers delivers premium sound quality, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you seamlessly connected. The head-up display projects essential information directly into your line of sight, and the panoramic view monitor provides multiple camera angles when maneuvering. Advanced Park with Remote Park functionality makes parking straightforward, even in challenging spaces.

The F SPORT Luxury upgrade package elevates the visual presence with distinctive F SPORT styling cues including the F SPORT front bumper cover and 22-inch alloy wheels. Safety Connect provides emergency communication assistance for added peace of mind.

Storage and convenience features are thoughtfully integrated throughout. All-weather floor liners and cargo mats protect your interior investment, while the power liftgate simplifies loading. The 120-volt power outlet supports portable devices, and thoughtful touches like illuminated door sills, puddle lamps, and HomeLink garage door transmitter add practical elegance.

This 2025 Lexus TX 500h F SPORT Luxury presents an opportunity to own a vehicle engineered for discerning buyers who refuse to compromise between style, technology, and everyday practicality. We invite you to experience it firsthand in our showroom.

It includes a rear seat reminder to ensure everyone is accounted for, front and rear parking sensors for easy maneuvering, and four-wheel ABS for optimized stopping power. Emergency braking preparation adds an extra layer of safety, while automatic locking power door locks enhance security when parked. Off-road driving assist systems such as hill ascent and descent control help navigate tough terrain safely, complemented by an electronic parking brake with auto-off functionality for convenience. These features make this vehicle a reliable and secure choice for adventurous drivers seeking confidence on every journey. 2024 Ford Bronco Safety and Security Features This Bronco comes with a comprehensive safety package including rear seat reminder, front and rear parking sensors, four-wheel ABS, emergency braking prep, auto-locking power door locks, hill ascent and descent assist for off-road capability, and an electronic parking brake that automatically disengages when parked. These elements work together to ensure safety and security in various driving situations. 2024 Ford Bronco Entertainment and Technology Features Inside, the Bronco boasts a 12-inch infotainment touchscreen with FordPass Connect compatibility, allowing seamless smart device integration. Hands-free voice-activated phone calls and radio enhance convenience, while surround sound and a total of nine speakers including a subwoofer offer premium audio quality. The system supports real-time traffic data for navigation, along with features like engine start/cabin preconditioning via the FordPass app, ensuring comfort and connectivity on every trip. 2024 Ford Bronco Performance Features Performance is at the heart of this Bronco Raptor, featuring auto start/stop technology for efficiency, an electronic hi-lo 4WD selector, and a part-time 4WD system with on-demand setting. Front and rear locking differentials provide extra traction, while a tuned suspension system is optimized for off-road adventures. These features combine to deliver the rugged capability and responsive handling expected from a true off-road icon. Fully detailed. 2024 Ford Bronco Raptor 4WD 10-Speed Automatic 3.0L EcoBoost V6
